decisions.reason: The revised launch deadline does not change the digital PDF deliverable or its two-page-spread display behavior.
The deadline change does not alter the requirement to enhance low-quality images when needed.
The revised launch time does not change the author-name, author-photo, or photo-source requirements.
The deadline change does not modify the requirement that advertisements render clearly.
The table-of-contents accuracy and finalized-pagination conditions remain unchanged by the launch-time revision.
The revised launch deadline does not change how long article text should be broken up or when additional images should be requested.
The source changes only the launch time and does not select, remove, or modify a flipbook hosting platform.
The launch-time revision does not change the issue order, placement rules, or included articles.
The visual-style, branding, and color-use constraints remain valid without modification.
The deadline change does not alter the selected Inter typeface or its weight treatment.
The revised launch time does not change the article-ending whitespace standard or its current and future mitigation methods.
